## [Received the item (floor lamp) twice](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/6a112b7c0f8222f985429519)
Received the item (floor lamp) twice - first time broken into two pieces, second it is fully bent. This was for a $1000 lamp, with over $200 in shipping fees. I’m left with no way options to pick up the items, and now have to SPEND $$ to dispose the huge metal lamps, not to mention having to manage the delivery - with this heavy box left at the building entrance- not at the door. Extremely disappointed. My San Francisco apartment is now full of boxes and thrash, after wasted time , energy and no lamp.

May 15, 2026

* * *

Useful

Share

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

May 23, 2026

Hi Aparna,

We genuinely appreciate you sharing your experience. We are very concerned to learn about the repeated damage to your lamp and the inconvenience this has caused, especially with the disposal and delivery issues. We’ve shared this feedback with our carrier and vendor teams for further review, and we’re having a member of our support team reach out directly to assist you and ensure this is fully resolved.

We appreciate you bringing this to our attention, and we’re sorry for the inconvenience this has caused.

Lulu and Georgia
